agentic.note: consolidation cost not instrumented (pre-existing module, untouched per goal constraints); store holds 3 notes for 15 episodes

notes.latency: recall p50/p95 in ms; recall includes embedding of query (and records for layered)
notes.hit_rate: deterministic: golden answer text appears verbatim in a top-3 candidate
notes.judge: gemma4:e4b ranks shuffled candidates + sentinel per query across all three systems (one call/query); ranking only, never thresholds; best_rank is 1-indexed position of the best answer-bearing candidate
notes.sentinel_last_pct: share of queries where the "no relevant information" sentinel ranked last or was omitted (omission counts as last: returned beats nothing)
notes.episodes: 15 total: 3 real chunks from auto_alty/stimulus_log.jsonl, 2 real chunks from stimulus_log.jsonl, 10 synthetic (4 facts + noise each); golden set = 10 real + 40 synthetic queries
